description: The reasonable operating assumption is that calls, messages and location are available to the authorities. Whether or not any particular message is read, the assumption does the work.
energy_note: Self-censoring in your own text messages.

aspect: A social media post is a permit risk
description: Posts have grounds consequences: permit refusals, detention, and - abroad - visa and naturalisation consequences. The cost of an opinion is quantifiable and high.
energy_note: A post that could cost a hospital appointment.

aspect: Which removes the ordinary outlet for what is happening
description: The normal human response to a bad year is to describe it to people. That is precisely the behaviour that carries risk here, so the processing does not happen.
energy_note: Nowhere safe to say any of it.

aspect: EXAMPLE - why the network generation matters for surveillance
description: The Electronic Frontier Foundation noted that with Palestinian telecoms locked to less secure 2G, Israel may have interception access even to users of Palestinian carriers - and that both operators must route traffic through Israel and use an Israeli-registered company for international links.
energy_note: The old network is the readable one.
